Head of Key Accounts, Account Services Job Description

At A Glance: As the Head of Account Services, Key Accounts, you will establish focused leadership over our Key Accounts team, directly overseeing a team of three Leads who manage teams below them. Your focus will be on servicing our biggest established retailer partners in the US, cultivating a high-performing team, and implementing strategies that support our goal of becoming the leading sportswear company and furthering our mission to ignite the human spirit through movement. You will act as the key commercial liaison for operations, interacting closely with both sales and customer operations teams. A crucial element of this role is elevating Account Services to be the indispensable partner to our B2B Retailers, delivering premium account services while acting as the expert liaison to our internal operations.

Your Mission:

- Team Leadership & Development: Oversee a team of three Leads and their respective teams, providing focused coaching on communication, leading initiatives, and advocating effectively for business needs to develop a new Account Services team.

- Strategic & Commercial Liaison: Act as the key commercial liaison interacting with sales and customer operations teams to lead day-to-day business operations for our biggest established accounts in the US.

- Drive Strategic Engagement: Champion Long Range Plan (LRP) capabilities and drive strategic planning by integrating and managing new, complex operational capabilities, such as direct ship, drop ship, and pack by store.

- Cross-Functional Advocacy: Advocate for Key Accounts needs within the Americas Supply Chain, and Global Supply Chain. Guide process and policy change management with internal and external stakeholders.

- Operational Representation: Represent Key Accounts in operational flywheel meetings and collaborate heavily with global and local stakeholders to drive a consistent strategy across the Americas.

- Orderbook Management: Manage increasing orderbook complexities as the business grows while identifying risks to achieve on-time deliveries and sales targets.

- Cultivate Partnerships: Proactively drive overall Key Account success by leveraging data-driven insights to shape strategic decisions in close collaboration with the Director of Account Services.

Your Story:

- Extensive progressive experience in customer support, logistics, or operations roles, with a proven track record of managing managers (specifically overseeing Leads and large team structures).

- Demonstrated experience managing day-to-day operations for major key accounts while concurrently implementing and integrating new operational capabilities (e.g., direct ship, drop ship, pack by store).

- Exceptional interpersonal skills with a strong focus on relationship building, active listening, and effective questioning, enabling you to advocate effectively for business needs and communicate strategically across multiple levels and functions.

- Highly analytical with a demonstrated ability to make strategic, data-based decisions to navigate increasing orderbook complexities.

- Proven ability to design and implement strategic initiatives and process improvement to drive effectiveness in a fast-paced environment.

In short

As the Senior Lead of Footwear Tooling Engineering, you will define the strategic vision and direct the engineering execution for the bottom units of On’s high-performance footwear. Working in a highly collaborative environment, you will lead a team of tooling engineers to shape the future direction of our pinnacle performance products and technologies, actively advancing On’s sustainability and innovation goals.

You will act as the overarching authority on bottom unit development, bridging the gap between On Labs in Zurich and our Tooling and Manufacturing partners in Asia. From concept inception through commercialization, you will guide your team and cross-functional partners on bottom unit materials, complex geometries, and construction. Beyond daily development, you will be the primary driver for organizational process improvements, budget management, and long-term capability building for tooling across the company.

Your mission

- Technical Direction: Direct the holistic bottom unit development strategy for On’s performance and lifestyle products, serving as the ultimate technical authority on materials, mold construction, and advanced manufacturing capabilities.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the strategic engineering partner to senior leadership across Design, Development, and Product Management, guiding teams through complex design and construction constraints to achieve pinnacle biomechanical performance.

- Process & Workflow Transformation: Spearhead structural workflow evaluations, establishing macro-level process improvements to maximize global efficiencies, accelerate prototyping, and advance testing protocols.

- Manufacturing & Technology Strategy: Leverage deep expertise in advanced performance foam technologies and tooling constructions to act as the primary technical advisor to product creation teams. Guide Design, Development, and Product Management on design feasibility, manufacturing capabilities, and the successful integration of next-generation midsole components.

- Global Partnership: Drive strategic partnerships with our Asian tooling counterparts and tier-1 mold shop teams, elevating collaboration models and proactively resolving high-level manufacturing concerns and tooling revisions.

- Quality & Standards: Establish best-in-class standards for manufacturability and durability, overseeing the team's review of 2D/3D CADs and physical prototypes to ensure strict alignment with product specifications.

Your story

- Brand Experience: Proven track record working directly within a global performance athletic footwear brand. You must possess a deep understanding of the brand-side product creation lifecycle, consumer expectations, and how to align technical engineering with overarching brand strategies.

- Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in footwear engineering, specifically focused on footwear tooling, bottom unit development, and production.

- Technical Authority: Expert-level knowledge of footwear materials, advanced mold construction, and manufacturing processes. Deep mastery of plastics injection molding principles, structural design constraints, and tooling cost analysis.

- Software Proficiency: Strong background overseeing or executing 2D and 3D CAD work (Rhino, SolidWorks, etc.), 3D modeling, and rapid prototyping tools.

- Biomechanical Application: Extensive experience translating biomechanical performance principles into functional, manufacturable bottom unit designs.

- Strategic & Collaborative Mindset: Proven ability to influence cross-functional directors and leads across Design, Product Management, and Testing.

- Global Communication: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of successfully navigating and negotiating with international manufacturing partners on complex tooling and production challenges.

- Agility: Excellent project management and resource allocation skills, with the ability to manage multiple overlapping timelines and departmental priorities.

- Travel: Available to travel to Asia up to 2-4 times a year for strategic factory and mold shop visits.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Facility & Maintenance

In short

- As the Senior Lead - Facility & Maintenance, APAC, your mission is to share knowledge and provide high-level support to others while leading complex, high-impact facilities projects and initiatives across the region. You will own the strategic and operational management of our retail spaces, ensuring premium execution, optimal performance, and deep sustainability integration.

- In this role, you will navigate the delicate balance between being entrepreneurial and adhering to established routines driving continuous innovation in our spaces while maintaining the necessary structure, compliance, and stability for On's success. You will harness various perspectives from cross-functional stakeholders, foresee operational and compliance risks before they arise, and confidently make strategic trade-offs when necessary.

- We are looking for a collaborative, high level leader with exceptional critical thinking skills, strong emotional intelligence, and a proven track record of bridging operational and cultural gaps in a highly dynamic, multi-market environment. A key part of your mission will be to build and lead a high-performing internal facility management team for the APAC region. You will be responsible for hiring, developing, and mentoring a team of four members to support our growing footprint.

Your mission

1. Facility Operations & Retail Experience Excellence

- Premium Standard Leadership: Ensure all regional retail spaces operate at an exceptional, premium level, enhancing customer and team experiences through high-quality maintenance, infrastructure, and brand alignment.

- Operational Problem Solving: Strategically oversee and optimize the region's maintenance programs through our network of external service providers, focusing on high-level performance and efficiency rather than day-to-day tactical execution.

- Performance Analytics & Reporting: Track maintenance trends, operational risks, and key efficiency metrics using systems like ServiceChannel to provide high-level strategic reports and actionable recommendations to leadership.

- High-Impact Capital Improvements: Strategically direct "light renovations" and upgrades across the region, balancing creative, brand-aligned enhancements with rigorous CAPEX budgeting, forecasting, and cost controls.

- Support regional sustainability initiatives and ESG data reporting in line with On's global commitments.

2. New Store Openings (NSO) & Lifecycle Management

- End-to-End Handover Excellence: Lead the end - to - end facility readiness process for complex new store openings, establishing seamless, standardized transition workflows from Retail Construction, Facilities, Store Operations.

- Lifecycle Design & Feedback: Collaborate with design and construction teams to review store layouts, providing advanced feedback to optimize long-term maintenance efficiency, energy performance, and material durability.

- Utility & Infrastructure Setup: Standardize long-term utility setups and monitoring frameworks for new stores, optimizing initial consumption and long-term cost-efficiency.

- General Contractor & IFM Governance: Oversee General Contractors during handovers and manage International Facilities Management (IFM) partners to ensure flawless store acceptance.

3. Vendor & Budget Management (OPEX & CAPEX)

- Strategic Financial Stewardship: Strategically manage regional OPEX and CAPEX budgets, utilizing data driven forecasting tools to optimize spending and confidently navigate financial trade-offs.

- Regional Sourcing Strategy: Develop and execute a comprehensive regional vendor sourcing and procurement strategy, negotiating high - impact contracts with regional partners and IFM providers to ensure competitive pricing and premium service.

- Partner Accountability: Establish, implement, and track robust Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for external support networks, fostering strong, trust based relationships while ensuring strict contract compliance.

4. Compliance, Risk Mitigation & Documentation

- Robust Compliance Frameworks: Guarantee absolute adherence to regional health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations, integrating compliance seamlessly into daily, regional operations.

- Audit Readiness: Establish and maintain comprehensive, audit ready compliance records (including safety permits, inspections, and conveyance certifications) across all regional sites.

- Business Continuity Planning: Partner closely with Retail, Operations, HSS/Risk, and Finance teams to proactively address regulatory feedback, mitigate operational vulnerabilities, and secure business continuity.

- Centralized Data Governance: Ensure accurate, timely data processing in ServiceChannel and the FM Google Drive, leveraging analytics to drive strategic facility decisions.

5. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Consensus Building: Serve as a trusted strategic partner and liaison, building strong relationships and alignment across Retail, Real Estate, Construction, IT, Finance, HSS, Landlords, and Operations.

- Regional Communication Governance: Establish structured touchpoints and reporting cadences with Store Managers, Retail Leads, and regional partners to foster proactive alignment and transparency.

- Cross - Cultural Leadership: Leverage cultural leadership skills to bridge gaps between regional local nuances and global facility guidelines, successfully driving unified standards across diverse APAC markets.

Your story

- Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience in facility management, with a strong background in high-volume, multi-site retail environments, preferably within a direct-to-consumer (D2C) brand.

- Demonstrated experience managing facility operations across multiple APAC markets is a non-negotiable requirement. Candidates with experience limited to a single country will not be considered.

- Financial & Vendor Acumen: Proven expertise in managing complex regional OPEX and CAPEX budgets, driving strategic vendor sourcing, and negotiating high-value contracts.

- Critical Thinking: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex data, identify underlying operational root causes, and design structured, scalable solutions.

- Cross - Cultural Leadership: Demonstrated success in building consensus and fostering collaboration across diverse, multicultural teams, functional departments, and external partners.

- Emotional Intelligence: High level of self awareness and confidence; a resilient leader who approaches operational challenges and failures as opportunities to learn, grow, and instill trust in others.

- Systems Knowledge: Deep proficiency with CMMS/CAFM platforms (ServiceChannel preferred) and a strong commitment to data-driven decision-making.

- Mission Alignment: Passionate about sustainability, circularity, and integrating eco-friendly practices into facilities operations.

What We Offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose. Your Story

- Experience: 8–12+ years in footwear development. A background rooted in high-performance footwear and technical complexity is preferred.

- Passionate product builder: You love to build product that makes athletes better, obsessing over the details and the athlete.

- Influential Leadership: Proven ability to influence product direction and technical outcomes through partnership and advisory, rather than direct line management or project ownership.

- Systemic Thinking: A deep understanding of how performance tooling, materials, and construction impact the global supply chain and product lifecycle.

- Collaborative Bridge: Exceptional at navigating HQ and regional dynamics, acting as a "technical translator" between creative vision and factory execution.

- Strategic Judgment: Highly skilled at evaluating technical trade-offs and providing recommendations that balance innovation with commercial scalability.

- Consultative Communication: A trusted voice capable of guiding stakeholders toward technically sound decisions while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.

Attributes of a successful candidate:

- The Technical Advisor: You don't need to hold the pen on every tech pack, but you are the person everyone consults when a design pushes the boundaries of physics.

- The Strategic Partner: You focus on the "how" and "why," ensuring the category’s technical roadmap is robust and scalable.

We pride ourselves on a culture of technical rigor and "Swiss Engineering," where we challenge the status quo to solve the most complex biomechanical hurdles in the industry. Your role within this team is to ensure that as our category expands, our technical standards and the performance "soul" of our footwear remain uncompromised.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
In Short:

We are establishing a Global Technology Center in China to serve as a strategic R&D and innovation center for next-generation retail and commercial platforms.

As Head of Engineering, you will be responsible for building, leading, and scaling this hub, owning the end-to-end engineering strategy, execution, and talent agenda.

This role combines deep technical leadership, organizational building, and global stakeholder management. You will operate at the intersection of China’s highly advanced retail ecosystem and our global technology platform, delivering software products that power markets across the globe.

You will report into global technology leadership and act as a key member of the Global Engineering Leadership Team. Your Mission:

Your mission is to build a world-class engineering organization in Shanghai, China that delivers globally scalable, locally excellent retail technology platforms. You will:

- Establish China as a center of excellence for retail innovation

- Lead the development of proprietary, self-owned global platforms

- Ensure China-based teams operate as first-class global product teams

- Balance China-specific depth with global platform standardization

- Build an engineering culture rooted in technical excellence, ownership, and global impact

Lead with Vision — and with Code

- Lead and scale multiple engineering teams responsible for building globally critical retail and commercial platforms from China.

- Shape the technical direction, platform roadmap, and execution focus in close partnership with Product, Architecture, Security, and Global Tech Leadership.

- Stay deeply hands-on: participate in architectural design, challenge system boundaries, review complex trade-offs, and guide critical technical decisions with clarity and conviction.

- Act as a visible technical leader who sets the bar for engineering excellence, ownership, and quality.

Build Global Platforms with China-First Innovation

- Lead the development of self-owned, modular, and scalable architectures that combine:

- Deep local innovation leveraging China’s advanced retail and technology ecosystem.

- A unified global core enabling rapid localization across APAC, EMEA, and AMER.

- Drive predictable execution by breaking down complex initiatives, managing uncertainty, and unblocking teams to deliver consistently at scale.

- Maintain high operational resilience by enforcing SLOs, incident response standards, security practices, and platform reliability expectations.

- Continuously raise the bar for how teams design, test, deploy, observe, and evolve production systems.

Shape Culture and Grow World-Class Talent

- Build and nurture a high-performing engineering culture rooted in technical rigor, ownership, openness, and continuous learning.

- Champion global engineering values and principles through visible role modeling and decision-making.

- Coach and mentor Engineering Managers and senior engineers, developing strong technical leadership and succession pipelines.

- Own hiring strategy and decisions for the China hub, consistently raising the talent bar in a highly competitive market.

- Establish clear career paths, expectations, and feedback loops that enable engineers to grow and thrive.

Collaborate and Communicate with Influence

- Tell clear, compelling technical stories—translating complex systems and trade-offs into clarity for senior stakeholders.

- Drive alignment across global engineering, product, and business teams, ensuring shared understanding and coordinated execution.

- Build trusted partnerships across regions, functions, and cultures, operating effectively in a highly distributed global environment.

- Represent the China Tech Hub in global engineering leadership forums, architectural reviews, and cross-functional initiatives.

Connect Engineering Work to Business Impact

- Understand the end-to-end commercial and retail journey, and connect engineering investments directly to scalability, speed, cost efficiency, and business outcomes.

- Operate with a platform-first mindset, ensuring solutions simplify the ecosystem, reduce duplication, and unlock future velocity.

- Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term technical health, ensuring sustainable growth of global platforms.

Your Story:

- Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams (ICs and Engineering Managers) within complex, fast-moving, product-driven organizations operating at global scale.

- A strong technical foundation with hands-on experience designing and evolving large-scale e-commerce platforms, including customer-facing, transactional, and backend commerce systems.

- Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering Point of Sale (POS) platforms and solutions, including system design for in-store operations, payments, and omnichannel integration.

- Deep understanding of distributed systems, platform architecture, and integration patterns, with systems operating across regions and regulatory environments.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—you translate technical complexity into clarity, influence decision-making, and create alignment across engineering, product, and business leadership.

- A consistent track record of delivering high-impact platforms and products with predictability, quality, and measurable outcomes.

- Experience shaping system architecture, influencing engineering principles and technical standards, and driving strong governance without slowing teams down.

- A genuine passion for coaching, mentoring, and growing engineering leaders, and for building a healthy, high-performing engineering culture.

- Comfort navigating ambiguity, making high-judgment calls, and aligning distributed, cross-regional teams around a shared mission and technical vision.

- A builder’s mindset—resourceful, pragmatic, and execution-oriented, with a bias toward learning fast and iterating intelligently.

- An entrepreneurial spirit—you think in terms of platform leverage, long-term value, and ownership, and you act like a true steward of the technology and the organization.

- Collaborative, grounded, and energized by building platforms and teams that deliver real global business impact.

- Fluent in English and Mandarin and able to operate confidently in cross-cultural environments.

What we offer:

We offer a dynamic, challenging and sportive environment that has been ranked as the ‘fastest growing sports company’ of its time. With offices across the globe, we are an international team who is hungry to innovate and build something incredible. We foster an active environment where each individual thrives for excellence and can achieve their full potential. This is where your work matters, you’re hands-on and your team members are amongst the very best in their respective disciplines and fields.

If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our growing team send us your application, and join the ONiverse!

jobs.title: Store Advisor, Dosan Park, Seoul
jobs.description:
※ Please see the English version below.

In short

이번 채용은 On 도산파크 신규 매장의 오픈과 성장을 함께 만들어갈 DTC 스토어 리테일 팀의 핵심 멤버가 되는 기회입니다. On의 핵심 가치와 움직임에 대한 열정을 바탕으로, 모든 고객에게 진정성 있고 차별화된 고객 경험을 제공합니다.

Your mission

- 브랜드 가치 전달: 팀원 및 고객과의 소통 속에서 On의 가치와 브랜드 철학을 지속적으로 공유하고 실천합니다.

- 고객 경험 최적화: 고객의 니즈를 세심하게 경청하고 적합한 제품과 솔루션을 제안하여, 기대를 뛰어넘는 기억에 남는 경험을 제공합니다.

- 제품 및 브랜드 전문성 강화: 제품의 기술적 정보뿐만 아니라 On의 글로벌 활동과 주요 프로젝트(예: 지속가능성 활동, 선수 스토리 등)를 지속적으로 학습하며, 브랜드에 대한 깊이 있는 이해를 갖춥니다.

- 더 나은 매장 환경 조성: 고객과 팀 모두에게 더 나은 매장 경험을 제공할 수 있도록, 운영 개선을 위한 피드백과 아이디어를 적극적으로 제안합니다.

- VMD 관리: 프리미엄 매장 경험을 제공할 수 있도록 비주얼 머천다이징(VM) 기준과 매장 컨디션을 유지합니다.

- 재고 관리 지원: 재고 입출고, 제품 보충, POS 등 일상적인 매장 운영 업무에 책임감 있게 참여합니다.

- 기타 업무: 원활한 매장 운영을 위해 필요한 기타 업무를 수행합니다.

Your story

- 리테일 또는 고객을 직접 대면하는 서비스 분야의 경험이 있는 분을 우대합니다.

- 러닝, 스포츠, 패션 및 라이프스타일 분야에 관심과 애정이 있는 분

- 고객과 동료의 이야기에 귀 기울이고, 명확하고 진정성 있게 소통할 수 있는 분

- 밝고 따뜻한 태도로 고객을 맞이하며, 팀에 긍정적인 에너지를 더할 수 있는 분

- 새로운 지식과 업무를 빠르게 배우고, 변화하는 상황에 유연하게 대응할 수 있는 분

- 프리미엄 매장 컨디션과 비주얼 머천다이징(VM) 기준을 꾸준히 유지할 수 있는 분

- 신체적 요구 사항: 매장 근무 중 지속적인 이동과 대화, 청취, 손을 뻗거나 물건을 잡는 동작, 계단 이용 및 장시간 서 있는 업무가 포함됩니다. 상황에 따라 몸을 굽히거나 무릎을 꿇는 동작이 필요할 수 있습니다.

- 근무 조건: 주말, 공휴일 및 저녁 시간을 포함한 유연한 스케줄 근무가 가능한 분

Meet the team

On의 DTC 리테일 팀은 빠르게 변화하는 환경 속에서 서로 긴밀하게 협력하며 새로운 가능성을 만들어갑니다. 매장 팀과 리더십, 다양한 글로벌 파트너와 함께 기존의 리테일 방식에 도전하고, 매일 고객에게 기억에 남는 WOW 경험을 제공합니다.

본 포지션은 서울 도산파크에 새롭게 오픈하는 매장에서 근무하게 됩니다.

What we offer

On은 구성원의 지속적인 성장을 중요하게 생각합니다. 신체적으로 활발하게 움직이고, 꾸준히 배우며, 새로운 가능성을 탐구하고 실험할 수 있는 환경을 제공합니다. 서로를 지지하는 팀 문화와 함께 신체적·정신적 웰빙을 위한 다양한 셀프 케어 프로그램을 지원하여, 모든 구성원이 분명한 목적의식을 갖고 일할 수 있도록 돕습니다.

On은 공정하고 포용적인 근무 환경을 조성하기 위해 최선을 다합니다. 채용, 성장 및 승진을 포함한 모든 인사 결정은 개인의 역량과 직무 적합성을 기준으로 차별 없이 공정하게 이루어집니다.

In short

This is your opportunity to become a core part of On’s Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Store Retail team and commence the journey to bring On to Korea. On will rely on you to deliver exceptional customer service to each and every customer while embodying On’s core values and passion for movement.

Your mission

- Continuously embrace and communicate On's values and brand philosophy in team and customer interactions

- Provide exceptional customer service by responding to customer inquiries and creating solutions by listening to their needs and improving engagement with our product

- Maintain in-depth knowledge of product technical information and follow On’s global activities and projects (e.g. sustainability efforts, Athlete stories)

- Contribute feedback to store leadership to continuously improve store processes, customer engagement and team happiness

- Help maintain the visual standards in the store to deliver a premium experience

- Assist with inventory management and inbound / outbound product orders

- Other duties as needed

Your story

- Experience within a retail or customer facing work environment is a strong plus.

- A background in the Running, Fashion or Sports Industry is preferred but not required

- Strong communication, hospitality and interpersonal skills

- Ability to take initiative, learn quickly, and work both independently and as part of a team

- Eye for maintaining outstanding store condition and visual merchandising standards

Physical demands: This position involves constant moving, talking, hearing, reaching, grabbing, climbing stairs, and standing for consecutive hours. May occasionally involve stooping, kneeling, and crouching.

As you might expect from a young consumer brand, the DTC Retail team at On is a fast-paced place to be. Together with your store team and leadership as well as the global team, you will help to revolutionize conventional retail business and deliver the WOW to our customers on a daily basis. This team will work out of our brand new Seoul locations.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

The strategic ‘why’ is to eliminate operational friction for athletes and Athlete Managers, elevating On’s reputation as the most athlete-centric brand in sports. The Athlete Services Specialist role reports to Lisa Kroth on the Athlete Strategy & Partnership team.

Your Mission:

- Manage RPA inputs and end-to-end tracking for seeding, kit drops, and product orders, while partnering with Demand Planners and the EMEA counterpart on demand forecasting.

- Coordinate and deliver white-glove operational and logistical support for high-priority gatherings, key events, and the annual regional Athlete Summit.

- Oversee on-site event logistics, including nutrition, shelter, ground transportation, and coordinate personalized athlete gifting and milestone initiatives.

- Facilitate smooth athlete transitions into On's ecosystem by managing dedicated onboarding support and event-based communication channels.

- Proactively track the master athlete calendar and travel schedules to align athlete product needs with cross-functional product timelines.

- Execute administrative excellence by managing prompt invoice processing and financial coordination for athletes and external vendors.

- Professional experience in logistics, supply chain, or operations, with a strong understanding of order-entry workflows, product forecasting, and inventory tracking.

- Hands-on experience with ERP/RPA systems (such as Microsoft Dynamics) and data management tools.

- Proven track record in event planning, on-site execution, and delivering high-touch hospitality tailored to elite talent, partners, or corporate events.

- Exceptional cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate regional and global matrix structures across product, marketing, and finance.

- An athlete-first mindset, showing high empathy, adaptability, professionalism, and discretion when dealing with high-profile individuals and confidential matters.

- Event & Hospitality Execution: Expert in event planning and on-site hospitality, ensuring seamless operations and premium experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Apparel Material Development (Performance)
jobs.description:
In Short

As Lead – Apparel Materials Development Performance, you will take responsibility for executing the global performance materials strategy and advancing textile technology in line with the company vision. The role includes overseeing fabric creation, advanced material development, and technical execution, as well as collaborating across functions to support performance, sustainability, and high-performance product objectives.

Reporting to the Apparel Materials Team Sr Lead, you will manage material development projects across multiple seasons, support the execution of the global materials strategy, and work closely with Design, Development, Product Management, and Sustainability teams. You will also mentor junior specialists depending on project scope, and guide cross-functional partners to deliver innovative material solutions from concept through to garment production.

Your Mission

- Strategic Sourcing & Creation: Define, develop, and lead the creation and strategic sourcing of technical, high-performance apparel materials (including knits, wovens, and applicable trims or embellishment) in accordance with design briefs, product roadmaps, timelines, sourcing policies, and sustainability requirements.

- Standards & Quality Control: Establish and manage fabric availability standards, sourcing policies, and quality assurance processes, supporting target prices and adherence to program timelines across the global supply chain.

- Multi-Season Management: Lead material development workstreams within assigned projects, coordinating across multiple apparel product seasons to ensure alignment with program objectives.

- Sustainability Leadership: Drive and report on material-specific targets in line with the company sustainability roadmap, ensuring compliance, circularity, and supporting continuous improvement in raw materials.

- Technical Specifications: Create and maintain material and trim specifications, print applications, and related documentation using PLM system, supporting the adoption of best practices within the team.

- Lifecycle & Testing: Manage the material lifecycle, ensuring all textiles and substrates are robustly tested for high-intensity sports applications, approved, and continuously improved, leveraging expertise in yarns, fabric structures, dyeing, finishing, & printing..

- Supplier Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with T2 material suppliers (textile mills, print vendors) and T1 factory teams (garment manufacturers) to support material development, quality, and process improvements.

- Library Innovation: Contribute to the development and maintenance of the digital and physical apparel material library and tools used across the product creation team, supporting both inline commercial lines and special innovation projects.

- Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams — Design, Product Development, Product Management, Innovation, Sustainability, and Testing — across global regions (Eu & Asia Sourcing office) to ensure seamless alignment and successful execution of apparel material initiatives.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Your Profile

- Education: Bachelor’s degree (minimum) in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, Apparel Science, or a related field; Master’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.

- Experience: 8+ years of experience in performance apparel material/fabric development, with a proven track record in technical textiles, innovative synthetics, or sports apparel execution, including extensive collaboration with Asia-based suppliers and factories.

- Global Mobility: Extensive global travel experience to T2 material mills/suppliers and T1 garment factories to troubleshoot, create, develop, and source materials at the source.

- Project Leadership: Proven experience managing cross-functional material development projects from initial concept to commercial production across a matrixed organization.

- Sport Tech Expertise: Deep affinity for apparel design and technology in the technical performance category, with strong knowledge of performance fabric, garment construction methods (e.g., bonding, seam-sealing, knitting), and industry manufacturing processes.

- Innovation Mindset: Demonstrated success in driving innovation in performance materials (such as moisture management, thermoregulation, and lightweight durability), with experience managing multiple overlapping seasons of product development.

- Analytical & Organized: Strong attention to detail, with the ability to organize complex material data and deliver well-structured presentations and long-term planning documents to leadership.

- Leadership & Mentorship: Deep understanding of apparel industry processes, with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and mentoring junior colleagues.

- Communication & Negotiation: Strong collaborative skills and experience engaging with diverse global stakeholders, featuring excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation abilities.

- Agility: Able to balance creative design intent with rigorous technical organization and discipline, thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Your Team

The Apparel Materials Development Performance team develops and delivers the company’s performance and sustainability strategy for all apparel textiles and raw materials. The team conducts cutting-edge research, defines global material strategies, and supports projects that advance more sustainable materials, products, and manufacturing processes.

We work closely with cross-functional partners to embed material sustainability and high-performance priorities into the core of garment creation, with a strong focus on effective communication and knowledge sharing. As a Lead, you will contribute your deep technical textile expertise, drive the execution of material strategy, and ensure world-class fabrics and components are successfully integrated across our global sports product lines.

In a short

Are you a highly structured, detail-oriented finance professional who thrives on mastering complexity and running processes end-to-end? We are looking for a Senior Specialist - Accounting to serve as our dedicated, on-the-ground finance expert in Tokyo, Japan.
In this role, you will focus on high-impact oversight, compliance, and cross-functional collaborations rather than daily transactional processing. Operating as a critical collaborator between our local business operations, our centralized operations team in Shanghai, and external partner groups, you will support local financial integrity, coordinate statutory reporting, and perform key control functions. If you are comfortable making decisions with input from others, working autonomously, and communicating impactfully across diverse teams, we want you in the ONiverse!

Your Team

We are the advanced navigators of On. You will be based in our Tokyo office (Shibuya), serving as our key accounting specialist in Japan while remaining an integral part of the highly collaborative, action-oriented APAC Finance team.
We partner closely with local commercial and retail business lines to support hyper-growth while constantly seeking ways to improve local financial processes, standardizing where possible, and maintaining a supportive, team-first environment.

Your Mission

Your mission is to work autonomously, manage key tasks end-to-end, and successfully coordinate with diverse internal and external stakeholders. You will not be responsible for daily operational data entry; instead, you will focus on quality-control reviews, independent ownership of critical close tasks, SOX controls, and local compliance coordination.
1. Quality Control & Centralized Operations Partnership
Voucher & Reconciliation Review: Serve as the primary reviewer for accounting vouchers and journal entries by our centralized operations team in Shanghai, ensuring regional compliance and reporting accuracy.
Process Efficiency: Partner with the Shanghai team to continuously streamline transactional workflows, resolve day-to-day accounting queries, and improve overall operational quality.
2. Independent Ownership & Month-End Close
Salary Posting: Independently manage and post confidential payroll/salary accounting vouchers and related accruals.
Reconciliation Preparation & Quality Checks: Prepare key monthly and quarterly balance sheet reconciliations. Use the preparation process as a strategic quality check to secondary-review posting correctness and flag balance-sheet anomalies.
Variance Analysis: Perform comprehensive quarterly variance analyses to provide regional and local stakeholders with clear, accurate, and actionable financial insights.
3. Local Statutory & Audit Coordination (J-GAAP & IFRS)
Audit Coordination & Review: Act as the primary coordinator with the external accounting firm for the annual local statutory reporting process. You will focus on facilitating the communicating process, providing necessary inputs, and reviewing their deliverables to ensure smooth, timely/accurate delivery and sign-off.
Technical Knowledge: Leverage your understanding of IFRS and J-GAAP to facilitate clear communication and ensure high-quality reviews of all deliverables.
4. SOX Control Performance
Control Execution: Act as a key SOX control performer (Finance related), ensuring that local processes comply with corporate governance structures.
Risk Mitigation: Execute control environments within your scope diligently, actively identifying, reporting, and resolving process variances.
5. Cross-Functional Partnering & Stakeholder Coordination
Internal Coordination: Act as the key accounting contact for local Japanese commercial, retail, and operational business teams—resolving day-to-day inquiries and helping them navigate financial processes clearly.
External Stakeholder Coordination: Manage and coordinate communications with local external partners, including banks, legal advisors, and relevant local authorities.

Your Story

- Experience: 8-10 years of progressive professional experience in accounting or finance, ideally within a multinational enterprise (retail, FMCG, or consumer goods sectors preferred).

- Technical Expertise: Strong technical foundation and understanding of both J-GAAP and IFRS. Experience collaborating with external audit firms (i.e. Big 4 firms) is a plus.

- Autonomy & Prioritization: A self-starter who excels at working autonomously. You are comfortable relying on your direct leader for general direction on new tasks while collaborating closely on prioritization.

- Impactful Communication: Native in Japanese and professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal). You can adapt your communication style seamlessly to coordinate with both local Japanese business units and regional finance teams.

- Problem-Solving: A proactive problem-solver who is comfortable with complexity. You ask the right questions to analyze situations, collect diverse inputs, and bring clarity to complex tasks.

- System Capabilities: Familiarity with modern ERPs (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365) and reconciliation/expense/AI tools is highly valued.

What We Offer

We offer a sportive, challenging, and highly collaborative working environment with an international and dynamic spirit. At On, you have the autonomy to make decisions, drive your growth journey, and shape our local financial operations.
If you are ready to master financial complexities and support On's presence in Japan, we look forward to receiving your application!

- Drive Material & Tooling Innovation: Partner with material sourcing and tooling teams to test, validate, and implement new compounds, textiles, and manufacturing methods.

- Lead Fit & Wear Testing: Oversee rigorous fit and wear testing protocols for both adults and kids, analyzing feedback to iterate and optimize comfort, support, and durability.

- Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Act as the central technical hub between Design, Product Management, Sourcing, and Tier 1 factory partners to ensure timelines and margin targets are met.

- Optimize for Scale: Ensure blueprints and construction methods are optimized for mass production while maintaining the pristine aesthetic integrity of the brand.

Your Story…

- The Technical Authority: You bring 7+ years of footwear development experience, with a proven track record of launching highly complex, performance-driven lifestyle or athletic products. Experience in kids' footwear development is a massive plus.

- Resilient Individual Contributor: You have the patience and persistence to navigate the long development road. You take full accountability for the technical lifecycle and thrive when managing independent projects.

- A Problem Solver by Nature: Ingenuity is at your core. You think differently, challenge the status quo, and find elegance in solving the most difficult construction puzzles while maintaining superior performance.

- Global Collaborator: You have extensive experience working directly with overseas commercialization centers and factories, understanding how to communicate technical nuances across cultures.

Your Keys to Success…

- Thrive in Ambiguity: You don't wait for a perfect roadmap. In a fast-scaling environment, parameters change quickly; you view shifting priorities as an opportunity to innovate rather than a roadblock.

- Biased for Action (With Guardrails): You possess a strong sense of urgency. You know when to move fast and trust your gut, and when to pause to ensure Swiss-engineered quality isn't compromised.

- Comfortable with Constructive Friction: Innovation doesn’t happen in a vacuum. You welcome diverse perspectives, lean into healthy debate with Design and Product management, and use pushback to sharpen the final product.

- Continuous Learner: The footwear landscape—especially in sustainable materials and circularity—is evolving daily. You are naturally curious, constantly scouting new methods, and eager to apply fresh learnings to the PAD and Kids lines.
